name: Jayuya (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Red field crossed by a green zigzag band fimbriated in white, representing the Tres Picachos, the mountains of Jayuya.
history: Jayuya is a town and municipality in the mountainous centre of Puerto Rico. The flag derives its symbolism from the coat of arms and stands for a people proud of their Taíno heritage; Flags of the World records that the first flag was sewn by Hilda Chévere de Carlo in 1975 and that flag and shield were presented for the first time in 1976.

features.role: zigzag band fimbriated in white, for the Tres Picachos mountains
